# Sample TransUnion reports from the Errata project

`tu_planted.pdf`, `tu_clean.pdf` and `tu_round2.pdf` are test fixtures of the Errata project
(https://github.com/wjwhitmire/errata, `tests/fixtures/`), copied unchanged. They are generated files: every person,
company, account and number in them is invented, and each one says so on its first line.

They are kept here as an independent check of the TransUnion reader: they were made by someone else, from that
author's own knowledge of the layout, so the reader is tested on files its own author did not write.
